text_description: Runway look centered on a sleeveless, fluid midi dress with a square-to-scoop neckline and narrow black shoulder straps, worn close at the upper torso before falling into a loose, movement-heavy column. The dress has a vivid red base interrupted by black vertical panels and long suspended ribbon-like strips in red, black, white, and pale beige, creating strong linear striping from the shoulder area down through the skirt. Small gold-toned hardware or brooch-like accents sit near the top of each shoulder/strap area, anchoring several hanging strips that drape along the sides and front. The skirt is highly irregular and deconstructed in appearance, with multiple fluttering split panels and an asymmetric handkerchief hem ending around mid-calf, exposing the lower legs as the model walks. Styling includes a chunky gold statement necklace at the collarbone, a small green textured or beaded-looking handbag carried low at one side on a fine chain strap, and minimal black strappy flat sandals. The overall mood is graphic, fluid, and artisanal, with bold red-and-black contrast, dangling construction details, and a soft but dynamic runway silhouette.
